method_learning: Official data accessibility must be freshly rehearsed and checksum verified before selection.
Executable uncertainty and robustness procedures must be fixed before validation freeze.
A final result must immediately be copied into a governed receipt rather than remaining only as an ignored artifact.
Without specialist review, questions requiring interpretation beyond self-contained public evidence must be narrowed or rejected.

proposal.direction: Harden local provenance, preregistration, and durable-result controls while restricting future targets to self-contained interpretations.
proposal.scope: No external contact, no expanded authority, and no new territory.

approval.basis: Owner authorized continued local system improvement through direction-and-level approval.
